class.name: SteamWorkshopPublishRequest
class.brief_description: Branchable request for publishing or updating an app-owned Workshop item.
class.description: Get a draft from [method SteamWorkshop.new_item] or [method SteamWorkshopItemRef.edit]. Modifiers return independent branches. New items require a title and existing local content directory and default to private visibility. An edit preserves every field left unset.

method.name: described_as
method.description: Returns a branch with a replacement item description. An empty description clears this field. Supports up to 7,999 UTF-8 bytes.

method.name: named
method.description: Returns a branch with a replacement title of 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes.

method.name: submit
method.description: Use [code]await request.submit()[/code] to receive a [SteamWorkshopPublicationResult]. Steam uploads the chosen content and preview. Keep those paths available while Steam may still complete a submitted update. [param change_notes] supports up to 7,999 UTF-8 bytes. If Steam has already created an item, an interrupted upload can return its published ID even when [member SteamResult.ok] is false. When [member SteamWorkshopPublication.needs_legal_agreement] is true, offer [method SteamWorkshop.show_legal_agreement] and check [method SteamWorkshop.legal_agreement_status] after the author closes the overlay. Continue a known item through [method SteamWorkshopItemRef.edit] using the original published ID.

method.name: tagged
method.description: Returns a branch that includes this tag in the replacement set. Supply up to 16 distinct tags using printable characters other than commas. A tag supports up to 255 UTF-8 bytes, and Steam also bounds the combined set. Leaving tags unset on an edit preserves the existing set.

method.name: visibility
method.description: Returns a branch with the selected Steam Workshop audience. Leaving visibility unset keeps a new item private and preserves an existing item's audience.

method.name: with_content
method.description: Returns a branch that uploads the selected content directory. Use an existing absolute local directory or a Godot path that resolves to one. Steam uploads the directory's contents.

method.name: with_preview
method.description: Returns a branch with a replacement local preview image. The file must contain at least 16 bytes and be smaller than 1 MiB. Steam uses the active app's Cloud settings to store the preview.

constants.constant: Restricts visibility to the item's author.
Shares the item with the author's Steam friends.
Publishes the item publicly in Steam Workshop.
Allows viewing through the item's link while keeping it out of global Workshop query results.
